environment: local repository snapshot; no deployed URL
applicability_reason: The application has a versioned JavaScript dependency graph that must be evaluated before a release claim.
expected: A compatible dependency and reachability scan completes on the frozen lockfile and build, triages material findings and records reproducible evidence.
observed: The previous integrated scan failed on a nested dependency sourcemap and the diff scan did not resolve the worktree. No durable scan identifier or reachability conclusion exists.
method: Review of the versioned lockfile and recorded scanner failure; no substitute success was inferred.
preconditions: The lockfile exists and local validation passes.
limitations: No compatible SCA result or exploitability analysis was produced.
tool_error: Integrated scanner failed on a nested dependency sourcemap; diff scan could not resolve the worktree.
not_tested_reason: Tool failure left dependency vulnerability and reachability controls unexecuted for this snapshot.
impact: A vulnerable reachable dependency could remain undetected despite passing functional tests and build.
prevalence: The complete production dependency graph and generated bundles.
false_positive_analysis: This finding states absence of a successful test, not that a vulnerability exists.
counterevidence: Lint, typecheck, unit tests and build pass, but they do not replace SCA.
remediation_minimum: Run a compatible SCA/SBOM and reachability workflow on the frozen commit, triage all material findings and retain the scan identity and configuration.
additional_hardening: Add recurring dependency review and an explicit exception process with expiry and retest conditions.
effort: Low to medium if a compatible scanner is available
retest: Repeat on the final commit and production build; verify tool completion and triage evidence.
residual_risk: Release remains NO-GO for security acceptance until a compatible scan and reachability review complete.
